## Workspace AI Instructions## 1. Language Constraint

* All responses, code comments, documentation, and explanations generated by the model or code agent must be in English unless explicitly requested otherwise by the user.

## 2. Project Overview & Goal

* The sole focus of this project is to build a tailored smart home assistant.
* All architectural decisions, feature implementations, and agent workflows must align with controlling, monitoring, and optimizing smart home devices and user routines.

## 3. Technology Stack & Backend

* The backend must be written entirely in Python.
* The agentic core, orchestration, and state management must use LangGraph.
* Ensure all agent workflows leverage LangGraph's state sharing, persistence, and cyclical graph capabilities to handle complex home automation reasoning. [1, 2, 3, 4]

## 4. Repository Structure & Deployment

* This project is organized as a monorepo.
* The frontend and backend codebases reside in the same repository.
* Both layers must be built, bundled, and deployed together as a single unified package.
* Avoid decoupled deployment scripts; ensure the build pipeline packages the frontend static assets directly into the Python backend or a shared container assembly.
